findings.summary: The producer brief's 'Recurring failure classes' section still counts relax/remove introspections and quotes their prevention text. The dependents list leaves this reader out.
findings.evidence: `class_summaries` filters introspections only on `status == Recorded` and `failure_class == class.id` (briefs.rs:356-361). It takes the newest case's `prevention` (briefs.rs:370-373), and `failure_classes_section` prints it under 'Check your work against them before you report' (briefs.rs:412-426). run/mod.rs:1195 calls it with `records.introspections` for the producer brief. The plan keeps relax records out of `introspect::read_records` cases (decision 6) and out of `retry_introspection` (decision 7) so that loosening text never reaches a producer. This third reader of the same records is not filtered, is not in the dependents list, and has no test. Fix: In `class_summaries`, skip introspections whose `prevention_kind` is loosening (`loosens()`; athena-context already uses athena-data records). Add a briefs.rs test: a class whose newest Recorded case is relax shows the earlier code-check case's prevention, or no section when only relax cases exist. List briefs.rs as a changed file and add it to the dependents list with that test. If you decide the producer should see these records instead, say why in a decision.

findings.summary: The plan says backtest has its own read_records. It does not: backtest re-exports `athena_core::introspect::read_records`.
findings.evidence: backtest.rs:36-39: `pub use athena_core::introspect::{… Records, … read_records, …}`; line 526 calls it. A grep finds no reader of `.cases` or `case_interventions` in backtest, so the conclusion (unaffected) holds, but the stated reason is wrong. Fix: Correct the entry: backtest calls the same `read_records` but reads neither `cases` nor `case_interventions`. Keep `cargo test -p athena-cli --test backtest` as its test.

findings.summary: The system prompt still lists the kinds as '(default, code-check or design-change)'. Step 3(b) only appends text, so the prompt would contradict itself.
findings.evidence: introspect.rs:1015 reads '(default, code-check or design-change), say exactly what would have prevented the whole class'. Step 3 changes the schema enum (1037) and the error text (1486) but not this line. Fix: In step 3(b), also edit line 1015 so its kind list matches the five-value enum, or reword it so relax and remove are named as the exception. Check this in the criterion 5 unit test.

summary: I checked the plan's code claims by reading the snapshot. Most hold: there is one candidate per job (store.rs:31), and `Candidate.base_fingerprint`, `changes` and `violations` exist (records.rs:779-787). `reading::retried_job` exists (reading.rs:1522), as do `retry_introspection` (reading.rs:1413), `cause_key` (hestia.rs:264), `addressing_request` (hestia.rs:282), `error_review` and `try_error_review` (hestia.rs:2347/2367), `read_records` (introspect.rs:320, rows built at 388-413), and `apply_answer` with its kind parse (introspect.rs:1484). The only exhaustive match is `mistake_report` (status.rs:1707), and there is a single `StatusView` constructor (status.rs:2293). The same-change rule fits criterion 1; it is exact when both tries share a base and is stated as weaker when the base moved. The `[gate: NAME]` text prefix is a crude way to store structured data, but it is defended (`deny_unknown_fields`, record shape out of scope), anchored, and read only for Relax and Remove. That is acceptable as a documented stopgap. The demonstrations run production entry points, and only the model's reply is scripted. The round-3 fixes (no default cases, no retry seed, no cause groups, one open request per gate, disagreements >= 1) are each backed by a test that would fail without them. One reader is missing from the dependents list. `athena_context::briefs::class_summaries` (briefs.rs:349-381) is called for every producer brief (run/mod.rs:1195). It counts every Recorded introspection of a class as a case and quotes the newest case's prevention under "Check your work against them". So a relax record's "[gate: test] relax …" text would reach the producer: the same leak the plan closes for retry seeds, open through another path. That is a major finding, so the verdict is revise. I also found two minor inaccuracies. Athena's two scope findings (reading.rs and proposals.rs are not deliverables) are justified by the plan and I do not repeat them.
